content: rayon granularity (official docs.rs IndexedParallelIterator; context7 unavailable, ctx7 CLI missing, fetched via WebFetch): with_min_len sets a desired minimum job length - rayon will not split smaller, but iterators already smaller stay smaller; with_max_len is best-effort (will TRY to split below it, subject to min). Both are hints constraining the adaptive splitter, not guarantees. fold documentation: rayon finds breaking points to keep cores busy but the number and position of splits is nondeterministic - fold/reduce results must be order-independent. For tiny per-item work, docs advise avoiding nested parallelism overhead (flat_map_iter vs flat_map note).
